findings.statement: The Connecticut Secretary of the State business registry (Business Master dataset, queried via the state's open-data SODA API) returns exactly one match for 'callejon': 'El Callejon Dominican Food Truck LLC', business type LLC, status Active, formed in Connecticut on 2026-01-10, registered address 152 Main St, Unit 5, Norwalk, CT 06851, NAICS 'Mobile Food Services (722330)', annual report next due 2027-03-31. This matches the declared Company entity type, the trade name, the stated city and state, and the declared line of business. No Norwalk mobile-food-vendor permit roster is published online, so the municipal permit itself could not be checked.
findings.establishes: An active Connecticut LLC with a matching name, Norwalk registered address and mobile-food-services classification exists, satisfying the registration expected for a Company-type account.

findings.statement: No independent consumer-facing footprint was found placing this truck in or around Norwalk, CT. Searches across Google, Yelp's Norwalk Dominican and food-truck category pages, Facebook, Instagram, Roaming Hunger and the Best Food Trucks Norwalk directory (loaded directly) returned no listing under this trade name; the Norwalk CT truck rosters list other operators but nothing matching this merchant. The only public trace of the business is the state LLC filing, which is a legal record rather than evidence of an operating pitch. A food truck requires a permit and a vending location, so the absence of any listing, social page or review is a gap.
findings.establishes: No observable operating presence for the truck in Norwalk could be corroborated by any independent listing, directory or social channel.

findings.statement: The representative matches the sole named principal on the Connecticut LLC filing for this business: the Connecticut Business Registry Principals dataset, queried by the business_id of El Callejon Dominican Food Truck LLC (001eq000011PNrcAAG), lists exactly one principal, whose name corresponds to the representative on the Stripe account. This ties the representative to the registered entity on an official state record.
findings.establishes: The account representative is the named principal of the matching Connecticut LLC on an official state filing.

findings.statement: No website is declared and none was found. The email handle Elcallejonfoodtruck25@gmail.com coheres with the trade name and the declared line of business, and the statement descriptor 'EL CALLEJON DOMINICAN' is a truncation of the registered entity name 'El Callejon Dominican Food Truck LLC' rather than a random string or an unrelated personal name. Nothing in the contact details suggests payment collection as the trade. A free-mail address and no site are unremarkable for a new single-truck operator, but they leave no merchant-controlled channel to reach the business.
findings.establishes: Email handle and statement descriptor both cohere with the registered business name; absence of a website is not itself a risk signal here.

findings.statement: MCC 5814 (fast food restaurants) is coherent with a Dominican street-food truck. The Connecticut registry independently classifies the entity under NAICS 'Mobile Food Services (722330)', which corroborates the declared product description and the trade name. Card-present fast-food ticket sizes are the expected processing pattern for this MCC and this business type. Note that the sibling Individual account acct_1UWIYn9hb7VgCNr9 for the apparent same business carries MCC 5812 instead.
findings.establishes: The MCC, descriptor and product description are mutually consistent and match the state's own NAICS classification of the entity.

findings.statement: The only dated independent record is the Connecticut LLC formation on 2026-01-10, roughly ten months before this review, which falls short of a one-year independent presence. No dated reviews, directory listings, local news coverage, BBB entries, complaints or scam/fraud reports about the business or its representative were found in any search. Nothing negative surfaced; there is simply very little trading history to observe.
findings.establishes: Independent presence is short (about ten months, filing only) with no adverse reports found.

evidenceNeeded: Norwalk Health Department itinerant/mobile food service licence for El Callejon Dominican Food Truck LLC - no public permit roster exists online, so request the permit number and expiry directly from the merchant and confirm with the Norwalk CT Health Department.
Photographs of the truck with branding and plate, and the regular vending locations or event schedule, to establish an operating pitch given the complete absence of a public listing or social page.

Confirm on the Stripe side that the account representative is the same individual as the principal named on the Connecticut filing, and establish why the contact email on the state filing differs from the Stripe account email.

Resolve the duplicate sibling account acct_1UWIYn9hb7VgCNr9 ('El Callejon Food Truck', Individual, MCC 5812) opened from the same email address 1.5 hours earlier with the same representative - decide which account survives and close the other to avoid split or duplicate processing.
summary: The legal and identity dimensions are clean and strongly evidenced: Connecticut's Secretary of the State registry shows 'El Callejon Dominican Food Truck LLC' as an active domestic LLC formed 2026-01-10 at a Norwalk, CT address, classified under NAICS Mobile Food Services, and the account representative matches its sole named principal - consistent with the declared Company entity type, trade name, city and MCC. The statement descriptor, email handle, MCC 5814 and product description are all mutually coherent, and no complaints, scam reports or adverse coverage were found. The single gap is operating footprint: despite the solid registration, no Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram, Roaming Hunger or Best Food Trucks listing places this truck anywhere in or around Norwalk, so there is no independent evidence it is actually trading, and the Norwalk mobile-vendor permit could not be confirmed because no roster is published. Total risk 10; treat as a low-to-moderate new merchant - clear subject to proof of the Norwalk health permit and truck/pitch photos, and resolve the duplicate sibling account opened from the same email 1.5 hours earlier before enabling volume on both.
